Section 1: Basic Level
Question 1: Co-occurrence Probability
Word "ice" appears 1000 times. "solid" appears in its context 150 times, "gas"
appears 10 times. Calculate P(solid|ice) and P(gas|ice).
Step-by-Step Solution:
1. For "solid": 150 / 1000 = 0.15
2. For "gas": 10 / 1000 = 0.01
Answer: P(solid|ice) = 0.15, P(gas|ice) = 0.01

Question 2: The Ratio Rule
Given P(solid|ice) = 0.15 and P(solid|steam) = 0.02. Calculate the ratio of these
probabilities for the probe word "solid".
Step-by-Step Solution:
1. Formula: Ratio = P(solid|ice) / P(solid|steam)
2. Calculation: 0.15 / 0.02 = 7.5
Answer: Ratio = 7.5 (Indicates "solid" is much more relevant to "ice")
